crossRefs.note: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him…
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…
not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you…
Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven…
Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God…
But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever…
I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…
With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

translations.web: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
translations.bsb: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse—
translations.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
translations.asv: (Yea, I have not suffered by mouth to sin By asking his life with a curse);
